name: La Vie en Viande
original_name: ラ・ヴィ・アン・ヴィアンド
source:
At a religious sanctuary deep in the woods,
Folly, the sect's leader, continues to eat the meat prepared by her husband.
She has no choice but to eat...even as she withers by the day.

At the end of a table that consumes her very self,
the church celebrates the couple's new beginning.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/15025]Novelgame[/url]]
